description: This file contains unit tests for the GenerateSerializationAttributesAnalyzer, which enforces proper use of [GenerateSerializer] and [Id] attributes in Orleans serialization. It verifies that types marked with [GenerateSerializer] have fields appropriately annotated, and it tests the analyzer's diagnostics detection across various serializable structures, classes, and records.

classes.name: GenerateSerializationAttributesAnalyzerTest
classes.description: Unit test class for validating the GenerateSerializationAttributesAnalyzer behavior

methods.description: Asynchronously verifies that the provided code snippet triggers the expected diagnostic from the analyzer

methods.description: Test case verifying that a class marked with [GenerateSerializer] and lacking [Id] attributes on fields triggers a diagnostic

methods.description: Test case verifying detection of missing [Id] attributes on fields within a struct with [GenerateSerializer]
